text: {"lessons":["My account value rose from 98,409 to 106,573 despite some monthly declines, so I should judge progress over time rather than react to every fluctuation.","I sold A, E, and D for gains early on, but those sales alone do not show whether selling was the best choice; I should weigh each trade against my overall portfolio and goals.","Several months without trades did not prevent my account from growing; I can wait for a reason to act, while remembering that past price moves do not predict future ones."]}
